cards.title: Synthetic demo expense policy — not legal guidance
cards.text: Synthetic demo assumption only. No production legal approval or legal entitlement is established.

passages.text: Propose reimbursement of the documented expense amount and currency only when every prerequisite and exception check below is satisfied.
Require a sourced internal expense eligibility check of eligible, a sourced payment history of no_prior_reimbursement, and complete readable expense evidence with valid amount and currency.

Never infer entitlement from a receipt alone. Unclear eligibility, prior reimbursement, unresolved material conflicts, serious issues, unsupported actions, or insufficient financial authority prevent automatic resolution. Missing customer evidence requests clarification; technical failures remain failed runs. System 1 alone validates and executes any proposal.
